ui.title: Status Trends
ui.tagline: A dashboard of your tracker or gradebook export: how many items came in each year, quarter or month, where they stand, how that is changing, and what looks at risk.
ui.privacy_short: Your file stays in this browser tab. Nothing is uploaded, saved or sent anywhere.
ui.privacy_1: The page reads your file with the browser's own file reader and works it out on this device, in this tab. There is no server behind it: the site is a handful of fixed files.
ui.privacy_2: Every file the page needs is fetched when it opens, before you choose any data. After that it makes no network request of any kind. Try it: open the page, turn off Wi-Fi, then open your file. It still works.
ui.privacy_3: Nothing is kept: no cookies, no browser storage, no history. Closing or reloading the tab removes your data. "Clear data" removes it at once.
ui.privacy_4: No analytics, no fonts or scripts from other sites, no accounts. The page's security policy blocks connections to any other site, and the source code is public.
ui.privacy_5: Saving a table, chart or PDF writes a file to your own device, where you choose. Where it goes from there is up to you.
ui.drop_hint: Drop a CSV file here, or
ui.paste_label: Or paste rows copied from a spreadsheet, header row first
ui.export_help: How to export from Jira, or from a gradebook
ui.export_jira: Jira: search for the issues you report on (Filters, then View all issues, or your project's issue search), then choose Export, then Export CSV. Keep the Created, Status and Resolved columns; Due date and Team or Component make the risk checks and group table work.
ui.export_class: A class or program: one row per student per assignment, with the student, the date it was set, the due date, its status, and the date it was turned in. Export it as CSV from your gradebook or spreadsheet.
ui.export_other: Any other tracker works the same way, as long as each row has a created date and a status.
ui.settings_help: Status Trends guesses these from the file. Change any guess that is wrong; the dashboard redraws at once.
ui.as_of_label: As of (blank for the latest date in the file)
ui.empty_state: Open a CSV export above, or try a sample, to see the dashboard.
ui.footer_about: Status Trends is a static page built with Builder: every rule is in a tested Rust core compiled to WebAssembly, and the page only draws what the core returns.
ui.chart_table: The same numbers are in the table below the charts.
